name: Snap-lid food container
summary: A plastic box whose lid is held down by four hinged flaps that snap over the rim, with a soft ring in the lid to keep soup in.

parts.name: Box
parts.role: The clear box that holds the food.

parts.name: Locking flap
parts.role: One of four hinged flaps on the lid that snap over the rim of the box.

parts.name: Soft ring
parts.role: A rubber ring in a groove under the lid.
